caption: Press pause on the notifications with picks that celebrate paying attention. The Map of Tiny Perfect Things follows time-loop travelers cataloging small moments, Peak Mind offers focus-strengthening practices, and Walk With Me turns daily rhythms into meditation. More thoughtful picks in our latest edition of Wellness Pix.
